name: red-team
description: Adversarially review a document or code diff as a specific persona — a target reader or user with real knowledge gaps. The review runs in a fresh-eyes subagent with a separate context from the author, so it catches the blind spots the writer cannot see. Returns severity-ranked findings, each with its location, the persona’s reaction, and a concrete fix, plus an honest PASS / NEEDS-FIX verdict. Personas are reusable inline, per-project, or from memory. Supports a review → fix → re-review loop, and an integrated mode that checks whole-document consistency (contradictions, duplication, broken cross-references, terminology).
